description: The three-slot decomposition of one utterance (the parse recipe).

source.description: WHICH corpus -> which prg verb + corpus env.  Parsed from the source words, not assumed: 'who calls X / follow X' -> repo graph; 'when did X change / last hour' -> trace/log; 'in the L-server logs ... by model' -> log; a lone symbol -> repo search.
source.title: Source

term.description: The seed(s) fed to the verb (token / symbol / regex / span).  Obeys the fuzz-vs-anchor split: FUZZ the separator for a REPO seed; ANCHOR the identifier when COUNTING over a corpus.
term.title: Term

task.description: The downstream OPERATION on the tool's JSON, routed by the downstream-op table (find / count / summarize->doc / callers / when).  A long instruction fuses a SEARCH clause (source+term) with an OPERATION clause (task); the task must not be dropped.
task.title: Task

title: Slots
